_comment: ResponseHeadersPolicyConfig for `aws cloudfront create-response-headers-policy`. Attach it to the same cache behavior as the Lambda. Adds security headers, a fallback Cache-Control for objects that have none (originals, and derivatives written before v0.2.0 — derivatives written since carry their own), and strips headers that only leak origin details. Remove the _comment key before use.
Name: lambda-image-resizer-headers
Comment: Security + caching headers for images served via lambda-image-resizer
